scope: Reviewed API substitutions and moved controls. Evidence of intentional implementation changes, not a claim that every workflow passed runtime testing.

transitions.note: Source-group removal now requires a scoped current impact review, a matching store name, renewed consent and a durable receipt. Legacy direct deletion endpoints reject old clients before any write.

Sales guidance and improvement suggestions now read every saved section through the scoped, paginated section workspace with verified eligibility. Full text is loaded on demand instead of displaying only the first section and parsing away paragraphs. The old API remains registered but has no rendered query consumer.
Templates are read-only previews with explicit local draft choices; live catalog and settings are persisted only by final setup approval.

The connection workspace uses one scoped settings snapshot and explicit reviewed actions. Setup now uses a durable request and recoverable receipt; the old setup API has no UI consumer and is next for retirement.
OAuth starts explicitly as a mutation and completes only through a session-bound one-time callback. No client consumes the retired unsafe entries.

CSV/XLSX import now previews exact fields and errors before an atomic reviewed commit and scoped receipt. AI is now an optional file-form assistant with a durable request, cited suggestions, sample disclosure and explicit mapping approval before ordinary import review. It does not automatically insert model prose into products, knowledge or Sheets. Sheets sync remains in its existing disclosure pending conversion. The old createSheet checkbox never sent its value and was removed; no functioning provider option was lost.

The old product modal and bulk delete are replaced by a scoped editor and reviewed deletion with atomic receipts. All 16 prior editor fields, images, margin/discount previews, source locks and import navigation are preserved; currency and precise field errors are explicit. The old server CRUD remains until consumer retirement is audited.

Template list, create, edit, preferred ordering, complete preview and reviewed deletion use a single scoped writer with content digests and durable receipts. Images are retained as reviewed URLs and never auto-loaded in the editor.
Paged canonical quotation workspace preserves list, create, target, copy and status actions with detailed review, actor-scoped drafts, recoverable receipts and complete locally formatted saved text.
Replace immediate unreviewed sending with a durable full-content review, fresh explicit consent and recoverable delivery receipt.
Combined legacy/current requests; reviewed connection confirmation.
One bounded snapshot and complete client CSV/Excel/PDF; association is not causal conversion.
One scoped snapshot with currency/cohort evidence.
New session replaces visible context after confirmation; previous saved sessions remain recoverable, no destructive reset.
Observed trial metrics only, unknown customer metrics remain unmeasured.
Bounded paged takeover reads and independently reviewed option update.
Reviewed option update independent from unrelated settings.
List includes revision for reviewed writes.
Scoped reviewed sections/pages/FAQ, explicit preview before URL import.
Scoped paged list with coherent totals and reviewed mutations.
Bounded snapshot and full saved report details.

Upload with receipt, move complete file library and group deletion to linked knowledge sources; avoid ambiguous delete-all button on settings. Stage459 moved the remaining upload editor and recovery to brain sources; stage508 verifies those APIs at their new route plus the settings link.
Export currently selected ReportDocument on client instead of unrelated message report.
Remaining days come from the scoped billing snapshot, with unknown values preserved. Stage497 replaced the older current-subscription source and stage508 verifies the current component.
Reviewed import receipt and paged saved reports; pages/FAQ use canonical workspaces.
Replace invalid route tenant id and fabricated metrics with bounded scoped evidence, two periods, currency separation and complete CSV.
One scoped snapshot preserves all queues, stages, losses, currency values and conversation navigation, adds paging and distinguishes stored labels from verified outcomes.

Paged scoped orders, on-demand complete details, separately recorded payment state, reviewed manual status and durable receipt recovery replace stale-row updates. Invoice, margin, discount, payment attempts, Salla and Zid review tools remain available for their authorized scopes.

One scoped report snapshot replaces three reads. All report types, selected period, currency, metric definitions, sample limits, Excel and print are preserved; exports reject stale tenant or selection data.

Scoped paged customer identities and literal filters replace the unbounded list and misleading new/activity totals. Detail modal moves to the dedicated customer record. Previously missing note/tag mutations are now implemented through versioned writes and durable receipts.

Customer detail preserves order values by currency, loyalty ambiguity, paged source conversations and orders. Placeholder tabs become source-backed records. Account/store/customer scoped drafts, optimistic tag revisions and recoverable receipts protect edits.

The actual Sheets UI and prototype select a scoped sheet and explicit matching mode, preview original values and before/after changes, and apply one reviewed snapshot with a receipt. The old products.syncFromGoogleSheets/getSheetSyncStatus server procedures are retired after consumer auditing. The separate sheetsCronJobs product importer and inventory sync remain separate, pending audit; their retirement is not claimed here.

Inventory imports use scoped immutable reviews, explicit product IDs and quantities, atomic commit and recoverable receipts. The old direct import router and writer are retired after consumer auditing. Export remains accessible through the visible DataSync link and awaits its own correctness review.

Inventory export now reads the authenticated actor/tenant connection and requires its current digest and explicit approval. The old writer is retired; literal stock export preserves unknown quantities and verified price currencies, with bounded provider acknowledgement. Other Sheets settings retain their separate legacy APIs until their review.

The complete persona editor now persists a scoped frozen request before saving and recovers the atomic server receipt. Create and update behavior remains available through saveReviewed; the prior server procedures are retired after consumer auditing.

The home analytics now consumes a tenant-scoped consistent snapshot with explicit missing-value and bounded-product-sample evidence. Metrics, chart, daily table and product catalog links remain available; the old summary API is retained for compatibility.

Home source and sync details now read one tenant-scoped snapshot with stored group counts, explicit file extraction states, current audience definition and platform-specific sync records. Customer and source totals and integration-management links remain available. The legacy API is retained for compatibility but no longer drives this page.

The inbox now validates the merchant and conversation identity included in the history snapshot before displaying message content, previews or suggestions. Legacy getMessages remains compatible and returns the latest500 records. The new history API preserves message authors, media fields and the chronological window and exposes an older cursor for the next UI phase.

My-reply review now validates authenticated actor, merchant, conversation, kind and cursor on an identity-bearing snapshot, and hides cached rows while refreshing. The compatible listStaffAttempts API remains available with its original page shape; checking prior attempts remains read/reconcile-only.

Team review now verifies the current account and merchant in both permission and data snapshots, including mode, message kind, conversation, author and cursor filters. Compatible access/list/audit APIs remain available unchanged. Server permissions still govern every read and check.

Handoff ownership, memory, offers and message evidence now use a consistent tenant snapshot with authenticated account identity. Exact-source dialogs independently verify actor, merchant, conversation and message and require a fresh read. Compatible original reads and the ownership mutation remain available; stale and late UI actions are fenced.

Escalation review now validates actor, merchant, conversation, cursor and current permission before showing rows. The original list and review write are retained. Notes survive page navigation and transient read failures within the active workspace, and writes require current evidence and a fresh read after failure.

Offer review now opens a fresh actor/merchant/conversation/source-cursor snapshot and keeps notes in the current workspace across disclosure closing, pagination and read failures. Existing review/list APIs remain compatible; receipt states, conflicting projections and prior acceptance remain visible. Writes reject stale or contradictory results and update message/handoff readers.

The real list now reads a full scoped paginated snapshot with actor, tenant, permission and selection checks. Search/status/review filters and pagination are restored through URLs. Review still explicitly acknowledges all outstanding campaign records at execution; performance retains the existing APIs pending its own snapshot migration. Legacy APIs remain available. Sending subsequently moved to the detail review in phase254; its route-level preservation check is recorded below.

Campaign performance now reads all-time completed counters and bounded UTC success logs in one repeatable-read snapshot. The client checks actor, tenant, period, contiguous days and totals; copy explicitly distinguishes stored records from verified receipts. The original aggregate and timeline APIs remain compatible.

The actual report now reads a scoped, consistent paginated snapshot and exports all matching rows from a separately verified complete snapshot. Result history and recipient queue remain distinct; legacy getReport stays compatible.
Actual details use a scoped consistent snapshot, show the outgoing opt-out notice and bind explicit send confirmation to the reviewed definition.
List sending now navigates to actual campaign detail review; the first-party send mutation is available only there with the reviewed definition.

Actual editor uses an actor- and tenant-bound seed, count-only exact-filter audience preview, merchant-zone scheduling and explicit save review. Updates carry the reviewed definition; invalid saved targeting requires explicit repair. Legacy reads remain compatible.

Connection and complete paginated logs use scoped snapshots. Registration checks the saved identity; synchronization uses a durable request and recovery read. Reviewed disconnection and existing order-effect review remain. The old OAuth link had no implemented route and was intentionally removed; webhook guidance remains.

Connection status and complete local counts come from one scoped snapshot. Domain validation, connection check, reviewed disconnection and setup guidance remain. The prior fabricated zero revenue and empty sales log are replaced by navigation to the actual sales-operation workspace.

Five sections preserve overview, trainees, knowledge questions, academy pages and sales operations. Full paginated sources replace capped reads; FAQ selection checks its digest and synchronization has a saved request receipt. Queue acceptance is not completion, and enrollment evidence review remains available.

Existing routes render the shared reviewed workspace: connection/settings, product synchronization and catalog navigation, complete logs and notification review. Five settings and webhook credential rotation remain; settings/disconnection check the connection revision, synchronization has durable recovery, and incident acknowledgement covers only the reviewed identifiers.

Connection save/check/disconnect and product/order sync use reviewed durable operations. Complete logs and explicit incident-set reconciliation replace unrestricted legacy writes. Browser recovery reads an existing receipt rather than silently replaying a provider action.
One complete paginated product source implements server-side search and saved filters; reviewed sync replaces immediate sync and preserves operation recovery.

Complete order paging and details preserve items and notes. Synchronization, status changes and customer notifications require scoped review and durable receipts; notifications do not claim delivery from provider acceptance.

One complete period snapshot preserves sales, products and customer counts while separating currencies and exposing excluded rows. The old claimed conversation conversion rate has no valid causal denominator; the replacement explicitly distinguishes observed order/customer indicators from unmeasured conversion.

Four workspace tabs preserve overview, appointments, webhook receipts and booking links. Connection preview/save/check/disconnect, settings and bounded manual synchronization use reviewed operations and recoverable results. Legacy writes reject before provider or database effects.
Scoped connection settings distinguish stored linkage from live provider access. The explicit OAuth start and reviewed disconnect remain on this route, including local data retention.

Month/week/day/custom selection, full daily counts, paged appointments and separate details replace the partial grid. Cancellation and sync/reminder review remain; connection status is managed through the linked connection settings page. Appointment creation and availability remain separate from booking creation.
Complete catalog pages include category names and filters in one snapshot. Detail/create/edit navigation and reviewed archive remain; archive preserves referenced history.

Scoped editor context and paged category/provider choices preserve service fields with field errors, full review and version checks. Existing create/update actions remain; uncertain saves are not silently repeated.

A consistent scoped detail snapshot preserves definition, prices, configuration, providers, six booking summaries, latest ten bookings and review distribution, with unknown data explicit and links to editing and bookings.
Category list and editor share complete scoped catalog sources while preserving create/edit/archive and optional fields; reviewed writes check saved definitions.
Package list/editor preserve package fields and multi-service selection using complete paged catalog choices; reviewed create/edit/archive remain.

Full filtered paging and matching summary replace the capped list. Detailed create/review and independent details retain all fields and the actual calendar, notification, payment-renewal and checkout-review tools. Creation still lacks a durable client idempotency key and is not claimed fully recoverable.

A scoped platform snapshot and independent calendar/Sheets cards preserve statuses and navigation. Destructive disconnect buttons intentionally move to each platform workspace where the merchant reviews identity, retained data and consequences; they are not silently removed from the product.

The scoped workspace replaces separate list/stat reads with complete counts and 25-row filtered pages. Create templates and all existing mutations remain reachable. Update and delete now require the exact reviewed revision; nullable limits can be explicitly cleared.

Full selected-tenant workspace replaces first-code reads. Explicit owner-only canonical merchant invitation, reviewed atomic application, record-only claim. Legacy reads remain read-only compatibility endpoints. Signup carries a validated code through setup to explicit review, never auto-applies.

Full selected-tenant workspace, reviewed record-only recovery, tenant-channel reminders and paged durable receipts replace all four legacy endpoints. Legacy endpoints now fail closed and the global sender, automatic discount and cron are retired. Automatic policy and provider-evidence reconciliation remain open.

Full selected-tenant source with separately labelled stored counts and canonical outbox evidence replaces partial UI reads. Creating saves disabled; activation and pause require a scoped revision review. Existing direct endpoints remain transitional until retirement; ongoing worker authority is not claimed solved by this page.

The explicit, selected-tenant owner-only connection picker replaces implicit primary selection. Existing connection, text/image, save and delete actions remain present with reviewed content and no default recipient or returned token. Backend write hardening remains tracked separately. Stage509 replaces direct deletion with actor/tenant/snapshot-reviewed transactional removal.
The trial notice uses the same scoped billing snapshot as the subscription page; unavailable data no longer becomes an expired or healthy plan.
Selected actor/store identity replaces implicit current merchant selection; cart recovery and reminders remain in the previously registered workspace transition.
List, stored counts, creation, editing, enable/disable and deletion remain. Writes require explicit review and have receipt recovery; stored counters are not fabricated sales conversion.

The static reception guide does not need a duplicate user query or personalize a fake health indicator. The merchant route guard remains; account-specific connection evidence is in number management and diagnostics.
Full scoped source totals, period, coverage, stored tags and proportions replace the legacy query; missing source data is explicitly unassigned rather than organic sales.

Search, grid/list, counts, complete pages, details and upload remain. Remove deletes the library record only, not a storage object or its external uses; pending uploads have receipt lookup and closure.
Creation and editing save paused. Activation, pause and deletion are reviewed actions; deletion is inside details. Full execution history distinguishes acceptance from delivery.
Full review list, verified aggregate, star filters, details and scoped revision-checked merchantReply remain. Saving a reply is local and does not claim external delivery.
Booking review list, detail, service/staff and quality dimensions and stored reply use the same reviewed workspace; no synthetic customer reviews.
Templates and full delivery/incident history remain, with reviewed template saves and selected incident acknowledgements instead of an unscoped bulk write.
Store and personal profile writes are separately scoped and reviewed. Knowledge files and reprocessing moved to Sary brain sources; settings retain a direct link rather than duplicate the editor.
Account-scoped list/count and full details remain; read is explicit, delete is reviewed, and mark-all reviews an account-wide snapshot. The bell links to full management.
Complete paginated payment history, filters and status counts remain with currency-separated amounts; paid records are not a claim of provider settlement.
Payment details retain verified amounts, references and timestamps with safe export/print; the unimplemented WhatsApp button was removed, not represented as working delivery.
Complete link list/detail, reviewed precise-amount creation with durable request recovery, and reviewed disable replace old endpoints; counters are stored values, not settlement evidence.
Scoped saved settings and masked credentials, independent draft, revision-reviewed save and explicit connection probe replace raw settings access.
Account notification preference source, all current choices and revision-reviewed save remain; preferences do not claim delivery or change another owner profile.
Shared subscription summary and full payment-history tabs replace duplicate pages. Plan/state/cycle/dates/limits/usage and reviewed cancellation remain, with conflict and unconfirmed capture states.
Three shared tabs retain subscription consumption, resources and six-month history with explicit unlimited/zero/unknown semantics; reads do not reset quotas.
Resource landing tab shares the complete usage source and history with the subscription consumption page rather than the old partial counters.
All plans and features, current scoped plan, monthly/annual pricing, actual savings and checkout review remain. Unverified tax and provider readiness claims are removed.
The same complete catalog feeds selected plan/cycle checkout, exact price review and durable attempt recovery; legacy catalog lists are no longer required.

Complete reports, stats, products, estimates and scoped detail replace the old cards; deletion requires the reviewed version and refuses active analysis. Comparison and recovery sources remain independently registered.

The same reviewed delete UI now sends the frozen opaque snapshot. Authorization, exact target deletion and primary election are verified in one transaction; the legacy writer is closed before storage.
